mapper.select: SELECT lp.CORP_GR AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(lp.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , ya.CURRENCY AS currency , lp.JM_CD AS yjCd , lp.JONGA AS jonga , lp.DANGA AS danga , TO_CHAR(lp.LOAD_TIME, 'MM.DD HH24:MI:SS') AS loadTime , ya.BLBG_TCKR AS blbgTckr , ya.JM_NM AS xxYjCd , F_YJONGA(lp.CORP_GR, lp.JM_CD, lp.YMD - 1) AS junJonga , F_YDANGA(lp.CORP_GR, lp.JM_CD, lp.YMD - 1) AS junDanga , F_CURRENCY_RT(#{corpGr}, #{ymd}, ya.CURRENCY) AS gijunRt FROM SYT0LP lp JOIN SYM0YA ya ON ya.CORP_GR = lp.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = lp.JM_CD WHERE lp.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND lp.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND ya.JASAN_GB = '1' ORDER BY ya.CURRENCY ASC, lp.JM_CD ASC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO SYT0LP target USING DUAL ON (target.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND target.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND target.JM_CD = #{yjCd}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.JONGA = #{jonga, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , target.LOAD_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CORP_GR, YMD, JM_CD, JONGA, DANGA, LOAD_TIME) VALUES (#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), #{yjCd}, #{jonga, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NVL(#{danga, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), SYSDATE)
UPDATE LINK_GR SET SYT0LP = SYSDATE WHERE CORP_GR IN (SELECT COPR_GR FROM SZX0AA WHERE DATA_FILE != 'KSD')
